Coram : C.K. PRASAD*, J.S. KHEHAR
157 KICHHA SUGAR COMPANY LIMITED TH. GEN. MANG. v. TARAI CHINI MILL MAJDOOR UNION, UTIARKHAND (Civil Appeal No.77 of 2014) JANUARY 06, 2014. [CHANDRAMAULI KR. PRASAD AND JAGDISH SINGH KHEHAR, JJ]. SERVICE LAW: A B c 'Basic wage' - Connotation of - Reckoning of leave encashment and overtime wages wage - Where the 0 payment is available to those who avail the opportunity more than others, the amount paid for that cannot be included in the basic wage .:.. Therefore, amount received as leave encashment and overtime wages is not fit to be included for calculating Hill Development Allowance.
Decision Date : 06-01-2014 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 77/2014 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
